facts.business: Suyog Telematics Limited is a passive telecom infrastructure provider engaged in building, operating and maintaining telecom towers, poles and Optical Fiber Cable networks, providing ready-to-use infrastructure to telecommunications service providers under long-term Master Service Agreements.

auditor.name: M/s. Amruta Giradkar & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on provisional revenue recognition for tenancy arrangements pending final reconciliation with telecom operators; loans granted to related parties during the year accounted at arm's length with no impairment considered necessary; MSME dues identification and interest computation subject to ongoing reconciliations and independent confirmations, with no provision created on outstanding MSME creditors.

key_risks: Provisional revenue recognition pending final reconciliation with telecom operators
Loans to related parties with recovery dependent on management representation
MSME dues identification and interest computation subject to ongoing reconciliations
No provision created on outstanding MSME creditors as per MSMED Act, 2006
facts.related_party_note: Loans granted to certain related parties during the year ended March 31, 2026, represented by management as extended out of internal accruals at arm's length prices and on terms comparable to unrelated parties; accounted for and disclosed in compliance with Ind AS 24 and Companies Act, 2013; management believes loans are recoverable and no impairment/provision is necessary.
